Regular City Council Meeting
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1225 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California 90631
02:30 p.m. Closed Session
06:00 p.m. Regular Business
June 12, 2014
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1225 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Council's purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speaker's card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak.
During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speaker's card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Mayor. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Mayor may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Council.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).)

MINUTES
  City of La Habra Heights
  Regular Meeting of the La Habra Heights City Council
  June 12, 2014

Call to Order – Regular City Council Meeting

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 2:32 p.m., Mayor Bergman called the Regular City
  Council meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Mayor Brian Bergman, Mayor Pro Tempore Michael Higgins, Council Members
Kyle Miller and Jane Williams.

Absent: Council Member Roy Francis.

Also Present: Alisha M. Winterswyk from Best Best & Krieger, LLP; Shauna Clark, City
Manager; and Grace Andres, Deputy City Clerk.

3.  Public Comment on Closed Session

4.  Closed Session

At 2:35 p.m., the City Council and City Manager, adjourned to Closed Session to discuss
the following:

A.  Public Employee – Potential Separation and Appointment
  (Gov. Code § 54957)
  Title: City Attorney

At 2:46 p.m., Council Member Roy Francis arrived and joined Closed Session.

At 3:00 p.m., Planning Commission Chairperson Larry Black joined Closed Session.

At 3:15 p.m., Planning Commission Chairperson Larry Black left Closed Session.

At 3:17 p.m., Planner Katherine Leazer joined Closed Session.

At 3:53 p.m., Planner Katherine Leazer left Closed Session.

Regular City Council Meeting  1  June 12, 2014
Minutes
 At 5:06 p.m., Alisha M. Winterswyk from Best Best & Krieger, LLP joined Closed Session.

B.  Conference with Legal Counsel; Existing Litigation: G.C. 54956.9(d)(1)
  The City Council finds, based on advice from legal counsel, that discussion
  in open session will prejudice the position of the local agency in the
  litigation.
  Edwards v. City of La Habra Heights
  LASC Case #BC525436

At 5:54 p.m., Closed Session ended.

Closed Session Announcement – Alisha M. Winterswyk from Best Best & Krieger, LLP
announced that Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.1A5 regarding Item A,
Public Employee – Potential Separation and Appointment, that the City Council took the
following actions by 5-0 vote on each action: (1) accept the resignation of Jenkins & Hogin
and City Attorney Christi Hogin, (2) direct the City Manager to notify Jenkins & Hogin that
the City agrees to waive the 90-day termination clause, and (3) appoint the firm of Best
Best & Krieger, LLP as interim legal counsel.

  -------------------------------- End of Closed Session --------------------------------

Opening Ceremonies

6:00 p.m. Regular Business

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 6:03 p.m., Mayor Bergman reconvened the Regular
City Council Meeting.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Mayor Brian Bergman, Mayor Pro Tempore Michael Higgins, Council Members
Kyle Miller, Roy Francis, and Jane Williams.

Also Present: Alisha Winterswyk, Interim City Attorney; Shauna Clark, City Manager;
Doug Graft, Fire Chief; Lt. Richard Shear and Deputy Al Aguilar, Los Angeles County
Sheriff’s Department; Public Works Manager, Public Works Manager; and Grace Andres,
Deputy City Clerk.

3.  Flag Salute – Council Member Francis led those assembled in the Pledge of
  Allegiance.

4.  Presentations

  A.  Certificate of Appreciation to Avocado Festival Organizers

5.  Public Comments

Regular City Council Meeting  2  June 12, 2014
Minutes
 6.  Administrative Reports
  A.  City Manager’s Report
  B.  City Attorney’s Report
  C.  Community Development Report
  D.  Fire Chief’s Report
  E.  Sheriff’s Department Report

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis), and voted unanimously to approve
consent agenda items 7-11.

7.  Warrant Register for May 2014

8.  Treasurer’s Report for April 2014

9.  Adopt continuing Resolution in order to delay budget review until July 10,
  2014 - Adopt Resolution No. 2014-09 continuing the Fiscal Year 2013-14 Annual
  Budget until the adoption of the Fiscal Year 2014-2015 Annual Budget.

Resolution 2014-09: A Resolution of the City Council of the City of La Habra Heights
continuing the Fiscal Year 2013-2014 Annual Budget until the adoption of the Fiscal Year
2014-2015 Annual Budget

10.  2014 Review of Conflict of Interest and Disclosure Code and amending

Regular City Council Meeting  3  June 12, 2014
Minutes
 12.  Prop A Fund Exchange with City of Hawaiian Gardens

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis), and voted 3-0 (absent Higgins and Miller)
to authorize the City Manager to enter into a FY 2014-15 Proposition A Fund Exchange
Agreement with the City of Hawaiian Gardens.

At 7:53 p.m., Mayor Pro Tempore Higgins returned to the dais.

At 7:54 p.m., Council Member Miller returned to the dais.

  -------------------------------- End of Consent Calendar --------------------------------

Administrative Items

  review the Water Quality and Hydrology aspects of the Matrix Oil EIR

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Francis), and voted unanimously to authorize an

Management and Engineering per the scope of work dated June 4, 2014 and in an
amount not to exceed $20,000.

14.  Engage Mark Ostoich of Gresham, Savage to advise staff with regard to the

Special Tax for Fiscal Year 2014-2015, and taking certain related actions

Action: Moved (Williams), seconded (Miller), and voted unanimously to adopt Resolution
2014-11 establishing the FY 2014-2015 Special Fire Tax rates.

16.  City Hall Renovation Budget Update

Action: Moved (Francis), seconded (Higgins), and voted unanimously to receive and file
the status report on City Hall Renovations.
